Subject: Intro: reference check request for Sophia Khan (30 min)

Hi Rahul —

I’m a recruiter at Redwood Inference working with Sophia Khan, who listed you as a manager reference. Would you be willing to do a 30-minute conversation about her role, strengths, and collaboration style? If yes, we’d like to record the call for internal note-taking only. Recording is optional — if you prefer not to be recorded we’ll capture notes and follow up via email.

Suggested times (all in IST / please see conversions below):
- Wed, 21 May at 16:00 IST (04:30 PT)
- Thu, 22 May at 09:30 IST (20:00 PT previous day)

If none of those work, suggest 2–3 times that fit your calendar this week. Call length: 30 minutes.

Prep attached (short question list). Please reply with a preferred slot and whether you’re OK with recording. Happy to do a quick asynchronous exchange if that is easier for you.

Attachment: ref_questions.txt

Thanks for your time —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Recruiting Manager, Redwood Inference
